slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
（脑子寄存处?（?＞?＜）?）
（本书女主有点多，不喜勿入。）
不知名之地，一位女子静静立于虚空之中。
这是一位很美的女子，她如同仙子般飘渺，宛如从云端降临人间的精灵。
她所在的整个天地都似因她而被如梦似幻的仙气氤氲包围，让人无法靠近。
这种令人无法形容的美丽，本不该属于这片被各种世俗所沾染的尘世之中。
她清澈圣洁的眼神复杂的望向远方，呢喃一声：
“又是万年过去，通天古路再次开启，你还打算留在其中多久呢……忆无情……”
她的声音如同天籁之音，轻柔而悦耳，仿佛来自天际的仙乐。
她飘然而立，绝世而独立，令人心驰神往。
……
这是一处雪白的世界，一切都被大雪淹没。
这里荒无人烟，犹如一处生命的禁区。
但，却有一块巨大而透明的冰块显得格外引人注目。
在这冰块之中，竟有一位年轻男子。
他大约18岁之龄，面如冠玉，清冷俊美，好似上天最得意的杰作，黑发如瀑布般长至腰间，散发出一种神秘而迷人的气息。
他的白衣上绣满了精美的花纹，透露出一股高贵而典雅的气质。
他的双眼紧闭，仿佛在沉睡之中。
忽地，一股无上伟力不知从何而至，将掩盖世界的雪以一种不可思议的速度迅速消散，露出此地的面貌，上一秒还是一望无际的冰天雪地，此刻却焕然一新，景色宜人。
那颗巨大的冰块，也随之融化。

清风缓缓吹过，依旧带着一丝冷意，男子也缓缓睁开双眼，眼中似有无尽流星闪过，他环视了一遍四周，轻喃一声。
“万年又万年，但，我却依旧在此停留，不知何时才能再次观望世间繁华。”
他的声音带着几分悲凉与孤寂。
【叮！恭喜宿主忆无情成功在此自封了九次，共十万年，宿主已达到条件，恭喜宿主获得称号：“古今最强登天境”此次宿主再次卫冕第一便可走出此地。】
忆无情轻叹一声，整整十万载，他终于可以摆脱这个地方了，他在此地横推九世，终是在第十世有了出去的机会。
得知这个消息，他内心没有过多的喜悦，仅仅有着几分惆怅。
“你的奖励呢？”忆无情问道。
【回宿主，待到宿主卫冕第一，便可获得奖励。】
“呵呵，罢了，我被你坑的还少吗？”
忆无情洒脱一笑，也不纠结于一时，毕竟在此地，自己已经算是无敌。
他现在所在的地方是通天路之内，通天古路是仙界中最大的一处机缘之地之一，也是无数禁忌天骄的争锋战场。
每万年便开启一次，打开十年便会关闭，但若是过了时间不出，便会被寒气冻结，死在其中。
忆无情当年便是如此，他的天赋一般，背景一般，但他运气不错，虽然在里面经历了无数困难阻碍，但最终还是得以登顶第一，但被几方势力的禁忌天骄一同围攻，让他在最后一刻错过了出去的机会。
这也是因为当时的他底蕴不够深厚，对付这么多位禁忌还是比较吃力的。
content_en:
(Brain storage place? (?＞?＜)?)
(There are a lot of female protagonists in this book, so don’t read if you don’t like them.)
In an unknown place, a woman stood quietly in the void.
This is a very beautiful woman, she is as ethereal as a fairy, like an elf descending from the clouds to the world.
The whole world where she is seems to be surrounded by dreamlike fairy energy because of her, making it impossible for people to get close to her.
This indescribable beauty should not belong to this earthly world contaminated by all kinds of worldliness.
Her clear and holy eyes looked into the distance complicatedly, and she murmured:
"Another ten thousand years have passed, and the ancient road to heaven has opened again. How long do you plan to stay in it... Yi Qingqing..."
Her voice is like the sound of nature, soft and sweet, like fairy music coming from the sky.
She stands floating, peerless and independent, which is fascinating.
…
This is a snow-white world, everything is covered in heavy snow.
This place is deserted, like a restricted area of ​​life.
However, there is a huge and transparent ice block that is particularly eye-catching.
Among the ice, there was a young man.
He is about 18 years old, with a face like a crown jewel, cold and handsome, like God's most proud masterpiece. His black hair grows like a waterfall to his waist, exuding a mysterious and charming aura.
His white clothes were embroidered with exquisite patterns, revealing a noble and elegant temperament.
His eyes were closed, as if in deep sleep.
Suddenly, a supreme power came from nowhere, and the snow covering the world quickly dissipated at an incredible speed, revealing the appearance of this place. The last second it was an endless expanse of ice and snow, but now it is completely new and the scenery is pleasant.
The huge ice cube also melted.
The breeze blew slowly, still carrying a hint of coldness, and the man slowly opened his eyes. There seemed to be endless meteors flashing through his eyes. He looked around and murmured softly.
"Ten thousand years after ten thousand years, but I still stay here. I don't know when I will be able to watch the prosperity of the world again."
His voice was somewhat sad and lonely.
【bite! Congratulations to the host Yi Qingqing for successfully proclaiming himself here nine times for a total of one hundred thousand years. The host has met the conditions. Congratulations to the host for winning the title: "The Strongest Climbing Heaven Realm in Ancient and Modern Times". This time the host can get out of this place by once again defending the first place. 】
Yi Qingqing sighed softly. After a hundred thousand years, he could finally get rid of this place. He had been here for nine lifetimes, and finally had the opportunity to escape in the tenth lifetime.
After hearing the news, he didn't feel too much joy in his heart, only a bit of melancholy.
"Where's your reward?" Yi Qingqing asked.
[Go back to the host, and when the host defends the first place, you can get the reward. 】
"Haha, that's all. Haven't I been tricked enough by you?"
Yi Wuqing smiled freely and did not dwell on it for a moment. After all, he was already considered invincible here.
The place where he is now is within the Tongtian Road. The Tongtian Ancient Road is one of the largest places of opportunity in the immortal world, and it is also the battlefield for countless forbidden geniuses to compete.
It opens once every ten thousand years, and closes after ten years of opening. However, if it does not come out after a period of time, it will be frozen by the cold air and die in it.
This was the case with Yi Qingqing back then. His talent and background were average, but he was lucky. Although he experienced countless difficulties and obstacles, he was finally able to reach the top. However, he was besieged by the forbidden talents of several forces, causing him to miss the opportunity to escape at the last moment.
This was also because his background was not deep enough at that time, so it was quite difficult to deal with so many taboos.
